customCommands.name: test
customCommands.prompt: Write a comprehensive set of unit tests for the selected code. Cover edge cases, error conditions, and normal operation. Use the same language and testing framework as the project.
customCommands.description: Write unit tests for selected code

customCommands.name: fix
customCommands.prompt: Analyze the selected code for bugs, security issues, and performance problems. Fix all issues and explain what was wrong.

customCommands.name: explain
customCommands.prompt: Explain the selected code in detail. Break down the logic, data flow, and any design patterns used. Make it understandable for a junior developer.

customCommands.name: refactor
customCommands.prompt: Refactor the selected code to improve readability, maintainability, and performance. Follow best practices and modern standards for the language. Explain the changes.

customCommands.name: document
customCommands.prompt: Add comprehensive documentation to the selected code including docstrings, inline comments, and a header comment explaining the file's purpose.
